chapter: Kid Thomas band and dance work
title: Playing with Kid Thomas at Marrero and the band's lineup
summary: Playing for Spex in Marrero; Thomas's seven-piece band: Joe James, Walsh, Johnny Thomas, Twat, sometimes Lucha.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: you ever play over there? Well we used to play up there a long time ago. We used to, I played up there with Thomas up there, Marrero, we played for Spex. Uh huh. A fellow by the name of Spex, he had a little nightclub up there. He used to go up there with Thomas and play up there. We used to go to, Thomas used to go to wrestling, and dabb all the way to Lockport.
Did he use the piano when you were with him? Yeah, he used to use George James. So he had good rhythm there, full rhythm, huh? Uh huh. That good full rhythm there. Yeah, yeah.
Four men and the rhythm section. Yeah, sure. Thomas had seven pieces. Yeah.

Who was in Thomas' band then? Huh? Who was in Thomas' band? Who was the guys in the band? Thomas? Yeah. Who was the leader? No, who was in the band? Who was in the band? Yeah. Well they had Thomas, they had uh,

Joe James, myself, and Walsh. I don't know if you heard talk of Walsh, he used to play sax, sax. Edmund Washington, yeah I know him. Well Walsh, Walsh was with us. Uh huh. And uh, we had uh, Johnny Thomas on drum.
Wow. Wow. Hmm. No yellow on bass. We used to have twat on bass. Yeah. Did you have a trombone? Yeah. Huh? Trombone?
Yeah, we used to have uh, uh, Lucha used to play with us, with Thomas sometimes. Uh huh. Used to have Lucha playing with us. Uh huh.
